first.rationale: Provisionally prioritize onboarding simplification because it directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and has prior evidence of durable activation and faster time-to-value. Verify memory_86 to confirm downstream and segment effects, and memory_73 because promotional pricing is the strongest competing response but its evidence is qualified by pooled cohorts after a mid-test redefinition. Run a standard experiment rather than a broad rollout, and assess qualified-revenue proxies and retention alongside completion and activation so early-funnel gains are not mistaken for sustainable value.
